lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical stripes are visible across the lateral torso mass. Spacing is relatively uniform, approximately 50-70 pixels between segments, with slight compression at the anterior and posterior boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal apex of the 6th stripe from the anterior. A minor bifurcation or splitting is also observed at the dorsal termination of the 10th stripe.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior stripe is abbreviated, terminating in the upper dorsal third of the torso. The 8th stripe exhibits a significant mid-lateral discontinuity, creating a gap in the vertical line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior flank, immediately anterior to the hind limb. Density is approximately 4 spots per 5000 square pixels in this specific anatomical region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior flank align to form a descending diagonal geometric line pointing toward the stifle joint.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white facial chevron between the eyes, dual white cheek spots, a prominent white transverse band at the base of the neck, and white patches on the lower limbs.
